items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: You had Big Bad Voodoo Daddy, Brian Setzer, Royal Crown Revue. So all of a sudden I saw these young people getting into this music that I had been into for the prior few years.

ctx.x: That’s pretty good. Better than the $4 I made on my first gig.

Yeah it was a really neat period. Because the neat thing at that point was that was 1997 and if you remember swing music came back in fashion. There were a lot of swing bands out there that were making it in the charts again. You had Big Bad Voodoo Daddy, Brian Setzer, Royal Crown Revue. So all of a sudden I saw these young people getting into this music that I had been into for the prior few years. And you know my classmates didn’t quite get it, that I was into this older music, then all of a sudden they saw it…
I was going to say, were you a bit of a — have some notoriety in school because of your talents?
